headlines.description: — Radek Faksa scored a shorthanded goal, Casey DeSmith made 23 saves and the Dallas Stars ended their losing streak at six games by defeating the Washington Capitals 4-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stars beat the Capitals 4-1 to end their losing streak at 6 games

headlines.description: — Alexandre Texier had a goal and two assists, Jacob Fowler made 28 saves and the Montreal Canadiens beat the Calgary Flames 4-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alexandre Texier has a goal and 2 assists in Canadiens' 4-1 win over the Flames

events.name: St. Louis Blues at Chicago Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Oliver Moore and Connor Murphy scored during Chicago's four-goal second period, and the Blackhawks beat the St. Louis Blues 7-3 on Wednesday night for their fourth consecutive win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Moore and Murphy help the Blackhawks beat the Blues 7-3 for their 4th straight win

headlines.description: — Lawson Crouse and John Marino scored in a 3:21 span in the first period, Karel Vejmelka made 33 saves and the Utah Mammoth beat the Ottawa Senators 3-1 on Wednesday night to cap a big day for the franchise.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mammoth beat Senators 3-1 hours after NHL awards Utah 2027 Winter Classic

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — William Eklund scored 3:08 into overtime, Macklin Celebrini had the tying goal and two assists to extend his point streak to 12 games, and the San Jose Sharks defeated the Los Angeles Kings 4-3 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celebrini extends point streak to 12 games as Sharks beat Kings 4-3 in overtime
